build_cgnet_backbone: build a CGNet backbone model with default 32, 64, 128 channels for semantic segmentation
create_context_guided_block: create a ContextGuidedBlock with configurable dilation, reduction, and skip connection for feature extraction
build_global_context_extractor: build a GlobalContextExtractor module that refines joint features using adaptive average pooling and channel attention
create_input_injection: create an InputInjection downsampling module with configurable number of average pooling layers
test_cgnet_forward: test the CGNet forward pass to verify multi-stage feature map output with skip connections
